messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still in the center of the frame while the camera orbits around him, showing his front, side, and back profiles.","camera":"A full-body shot that slowly rotates 360 degrees around the standing character at a low-to-mid angle.","clothing":"A light-colored plaid button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, brown leather suspenders, a dark bow tie, dark grey trousers, and brown shoes.","hair_color":"Dark brown or black.","hairstyle":"Short dark hair on the sides with a small top-knot or ponytail at the back of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered young man with a slim build, light brown skin, and a short beard.","scene":"An outdoor paved area under a large concrete overpass or bridge structure, with graffiti-covered walls, barriers, and distant buildings visible in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a bright city rooftop with cranes and buildings to a shaded underpass/road area with concrete beams, graffiti walls, barriers, and distant buildings. The character, clothing, hairstyle, standing pose, and orbiting full-body camera remain consistent with the source.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original city rooftop scene with the underpass/road environment from the reference image, while preserving the same person, hairstyle, outfit, expression, action, camera framing/movement, and natural lighting.
uncertain: Exact match of the new environment to the reference image is uncertain because the camera orbits and only parts of the underpass are visible at a time.
unexpected_changes: The new scene is noticeably darker and more shadowed than the reference image, especially in later frames, though the character appears naturally lit.
